boundaries: Check and failing Compile preserve source/config/project/Snapshot/generated/Manifest/pending; successful Compile changes only output and bookkeeping. Captured external fields and asset bytes stay unchanged except explicit test-owned repair.

developmentHistory.actual: Compile incorrectly succeeded with missing saved Game Over ME; expected MV-ASSET-MISSING-FILE absent.
Compile incorrectly succeeded with missing title1 image; expected MV-ASSET-MISSING-FILE absent.
Missing battle BGM produced no candidate warning.
Missing saved host background produced no candidate warning.
Variable Troop selection produced no MV-ASSET-DYNAMIC-STOP explanation.
94 passed,2 failed because test setup defaults reinserted removed title1/title2 names. Fixed test input with explicit undefined override, omitted by native JSON; reran full suite.
Preserved existing MV-E301-CONTEXT warnings for Common/Troop roots; counted shared errors by diagnostic headers rather than counting both path and chain repetitions.

applicability.reason: B14 is a relationship from a current Map Event to its host carrier, not a fixed target selected by an event parameter. buildCompileOutput must read that captured Map object to preserve the current root. Removing its addressable Map first fails existing Map reference/materialization validation; AV.C07.host-map-required.formal.case.expected demonstrates the real public prerequisite. No fake missing asset target or successful asset gate is claimed.

nativeAcceptance: No native acceptance claimed by09; N05/N06 evidence belongs to assigned native owner/final acceptance.
